scanNote:
AmE-BrE qo'llanmasining UChINChI beti. Bosilgan bet raqami: 166.

Bu bet oldingi ikkitasidan FARQ QILADI: 164-165-betlarda faqat SO'ZLAR ro'yxati bor edi, bu yerda esa GRAMMATIKA, IMLO va PREDLOG farqlari berilgan.

Uch bo'lim:
• Grammar — 5 juft gap
• Spelling — 15 juft so'z
• Expressions with prepositions and particles — 7 juft ibora

⚠ HALOL IZOH 1: kitob 'realize → realise' deb bergan. Aslida Britaniyada '-ize' shakli ham to'g'ri hisoblanadi (Oksford lug'ati aynan '-ize' ni afzal ko'radi). '-ise' esa keng tarqalgan va gazetalarda ko'proq ishlatiladi.

⚠ HALOL IZOH 2: kitob 'in the future → in future' deb bergan. Aslida Britaniyada IKKALASI ham bor, lekin MA'NOSI BOShQA: 'in future' = bundan keyin; 'in the future' = kelajakda (qachondir). Bu — oddiy AmE/BrE farqi emas.

⚠ HALOL IZOH 3: 'aluminum/aluminium' — bu faqat imlo emas, TALAFFUZ ham boshqa: AmE [a-LU-mi-nam] (4 bo'g'in), BrE [al-yu-MIN-i-am] (5 bo'g'in).

⚠ Bu bet 159-betdagi 'different FROM' qoidasini tasdiqlaydi.

sections.title: American English - British English Guide (3): Grammar, Spelling, Prepositions

exercises.instructionEn: Grammar: five differences between American and British English.
exercises.instructionUz: Grammatika: Amerika va Britaniya inglizchasi orasidagi besh farq.
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ BU BET OLDINGI IKKITASIDAN FARQ
QILADI.

  164-165-betlarda faqat SO'ZLAR ro'yxati
  bor edi.

  Bu yerda esa GRAMMATIKA, IMLO va
  PREDLOG farqlari.


'GRAMMAR' BO'LIMI — 5 JUFT:

  1  AmE: He just left. /
          He has just left.
     BrE: He has just left.

  2  AmE: We saw that film.
     BrE: We have seen that film.

  3  AmE: Did he hand in the report yet?
     BrE: Has he handed in the report yet?

  4  AmE: Hello, is this David?
     BrE: Hello, is that David?

  5  AmE: Do you have a ticket? /
          Have you got a ticket?
     BrE: Have you got a ticket?


⚠⚠ ASOSIY FARQ — PRESENT PERFECT:

  1, 2 va 3-juftlar bir xil qoidaga
  tegishli:

  ⚠ BRITANIYADA 'just', 'yet', 'already'
  bilan PRESENT PERFECT ('have/has +
  3-shakl') ISHLATILADI.

  ⚠ AMERIKADA esa PAST SIMPLE ham
  mumkin.

     BrE: 'He HAS JUST LEFT.'      ✓
     AmE: 'He JUST LEFT.'          ✓ ham

     BrE: 'Have you finished YET?'  ✓
     AmE: 'Did you finish YET?'     ✓ ham

  ⚠ MUHIM: Enterprise kitobi BRITANIYA
  inglizchasida — shuning uchun
  MASHQLARDA PRESENT PERFECT yozing.


⚠ 'JUST', 'YET', 'ALREADY' O'RNI:

     JUST — 'have' bilan asosiy fe'l
        ORASIDA:
        'He has JUST left.'

     ALREADY — xuddi shu joyda:
        'I have ALREADY seen it.'

     YET — gap OXIRIDA (savol va
        inkorda):
        'Has he handed it in YET?'
        'I haven't finished YET.'


⚠⚠ 4-JUFT — TELEFONDA GAPIRISh:

     AmE: 'Hello, is THIS David?'
     BrE: 'Hello, is THAT David?'

  ⚠ Bu — juda amaliy farq!

  ⚠ Britaniyaliklar telefonda NARIGI
  tomondagi odamni 'THAT' deb ataydi
  (uzoqda, ko'rinmaydi).

  ⚠ Amerikaliklar esa 'THIS' deydi.

  ⚠ O'zingizni tanishtirganda ikkalasida
  ham: 'THIS IS Aziz speaking.'


⚠ 5-JUFT — 'HAVE GOT' va 'DO YOU HAVE':

     BrE: 'HAVE YOU GOT a ticket?'
     AmE: 'DO YOU HAVE a ticket?'

  ⚠ Ikkalasi ham EGALIK bildiradi.

  ⚠ 'have got' — BrE da ko'proq;
  ⚠ 'do you have' — AmE da ko'proq,
     lekin BrE da ham ishlatiladi.

  ⚠ INKOR:
     BrE: 'I haven't got a car.'
     AmE: 'I don't have a car.'

  ⚠ Kitobda 'have got' asosiy shakl
  sifatida o'rgatilgan (Photo File 3-unit varag'i va
  boshqalar).


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  grammar     = grammatika
  spelling    = imlo
  a preposition = predlog
  a particle  = yuklama (up, in, off ...)
  an expression = ibora
  to hand in  = topshirmoq
  a report    = hisobot

exercises.instructionEn: Spelling: match the American spelling to the British spelling.
exercises.instructionUz: Imlo: Amerika imlosini Britaniya imlosi bilan moslang.
exercises.explanationUz:
'SPELLING' BO'LIMI — 15 JUFT.

  ⚠ Bu so'zlar bir xil o'qiladi (bittadan
  tashqari), faqat IMLOsi boshqa.


TO'LIQ RO'YXAT (AmE → BrE):

  aluminum      → aluminium
  analyze       → analyse
  center        → centre
  check (n)     → cheque (n)
  color         → colour
  defense       → defence
  honor         → honour
  jewelry       → jewellery
  labor         → labour
  practice (n,v) → practice (n),
                   practise (v)
  program       → programme
  realize       → realise
  theater       → theatre
  tire          → tyre
  trave(l)ler   → traveller


⚠⚠ BESh ASOSIY QOIDA:

  1) '-OR' → '-OUR'
     color → colour
     honor → honour
     labor → labour
     ⚠ Yana: favor/favour,
       neighbor/neighbour

  2) '-ER' → '-RE'
     center → centre
     theater → theatre
     ⚠ Yana: meter/metre, liter/litre

  3) '-IZE' → '-ISE'
     analyze → analyse
     realize → realise
     ⚠ Yana: organize/organise

  4) '-SE' → '-CE'
     defense → defence
     ⚠ Yana: offense/offence,
       license/licence

  5) BITTA 'L' → IKKITA 'L'
     traveler → traveller
     ⚠ Yana: traveling/travelling,
       canceled/cancelled


⚠⚠ 'PRACTICE / PRACTISE' — ENG NOZIK:

  BRITANIYADA ot va fe'l BOShQAChA
  yoziladi:

     'practiCe' — OT   ('c' bilan)
        'football practice'
     'practiSe' — FE'L ('s' bilan)
        'to practise the piano'

  ⚠ Amerikada IKKALASI ham 'practice'.

  ⚠⚠ PHOTO FILE 14-UNIT VARAG'IDAGI 'ADVICE/ADVISE' BILAN
  BIR XIL QOIDA:
     'adviCe' — OT
     'adviSe' — FE'L

  ⚠ Eslab qolish: alifboda 'C' 'S' dan
  OLDIN — otda ham 'C' oldin keladi.


⚠ 'CHECK / CHEQUE' — DIQQAT:

     BrE 'a cheque' = BANK ChEKI
     BrE 'a check' = tekshiruv

  ⚠ Ya'ni Britaniyada IKKALA so'z ham bor,
  lekin MA'NOSI BOShQA!

  ⚠ 164-betda ko'rgan edik: AmE 'check
  (restaurant)' = BrE 'bill'.


⚠⚠ HALOL IZOH — 'REALIZE':

  Kitob 'realize → realise' deb bergan.

  ⚠ Aslida BRITANIYADA '-IZE' ShAKLI HAM
  TO'G'RI. Oksford lug'ati aynan '-ize'
  ni afzal ko'radi.

  ⚠ '-ise' esa keng tarqalgan va
  gazetalarda ko'proq ishlatiladi.

  ⚠ Ikkalasi ham xato emas — asosiysi
  BIR MATNDA ARALAShTIRMASLIK.


⚠⚠ HALOL IZOH — 'ALUMINUM':

  Bu faqat imlo farqi EMAS —
  TALAFFUZ ham boshqa:

     AmE 'aluminum'  [a-LU-mi-nam]
        — 4 bo'g'in
     BrE 'aluminium' [al-yu-MIN-i-am]
        — 5 bo'g'in

  ⚠ BrE shaklida qo'shimcha 'i' bor.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  aluminium   = alyuminiy (BrE)
  to analyse  = tahlil qilmoq (BrE)
  a cheque    = bank cheki (BrE)
  defence     = mudofaa (BrE)
  honour      = sharaf (BrE)
  jewellery   = zargarlik buyumlari (BrE)
  labour      = mehnat (BrE)
  to practise = mashq qilmoq (BrE, FE'L)
  practice    = mashq (BrE, OT)
  a programme = dastur (BrE)
  to realise  = anglamoq (BrE)
  a theatre   = teatr (BrE)
  a tyre      = shina (BrE)
  a traveller = sayohatchi (BrE)

pairs.whyUz:
⚠ QOIDA 1: '-OR' → '-OUR'.

Shu qoidadagilar: honor/honour,
labor/labour, favor/favour,
neighbor/neighbour.

⚠ 156-betdagi 'colourful' shu qoidaga
ko'ra 'u' bilan yozilgan.

⚠ QOIDA 1: '-OR' → '-OUR'.

⚠ 'h' JIM: [O-nar].

⚠ Shuning uchun 'AN honour' — 'a' EMAS
(tovushi unli bilan boshlanadi).

⚠ QOIDA 1: '-OR' → '-OUR'.

⚠ Britaniyaning bir partiyasi 'the Labour
Party' deb ataladi — shu imlo bilan.

⚠ QOIDA 2: '-ER' → '-RE'.

Shu qoidadagilar: theater/theatre,
meter/metre, liter/litre.

⚠ 155 va 161-betlarda 'the city centre'
yozilgan — britancha imlo.

⚠ QOIDA 2: '-ER' → '-RE'.

⚠ 165-betda ko'rgan edik: AmE 'movie
house/theater' = BrE 'cinema'.

Ya'ni BrE 'theatre' — SAHNA teatri, kino
emas.

⚠ QOIDA 3: '-IZE' → '-ISE'.

Shu qoidadagilar: organize/organise,
apologize/apologise.

⚠ 'analysis' (ot) — ikkala mamlakatda ham
's' bilan.

⚠ QOIDA 3: '-IZE' → '-ISE'.

⚠⚠ HALOL IZOH: Britaniyada '-IZE' shakli
HAM TO'G'RI! Oksford lug'ati aynan '-ize'
ni afzal ko'radi.

Ikkalasi ham xato emas — asosiysi bir
matnda ARALASHTIRMASLIK.

⚠ QOIDA 4: '-SE' → '-CE'.

Shu qoidadagilar: offense/offence,
license/licence (ot).

⚠ Lekin fe'l shakli BrE da ham 's' bilan:
'to license' (ruxsat bermoq).

⚠ QOIDA 5: BITTA 'L' → IKKITA 'L'.

Shu qoidadagilar: traveling/travelling,
canceled/cancelled, modeling/modelling.

⚠ Kitob 'trave(l)ler' deb yozgan — ya'ni
Amerikada ikkala shakl ham uchraydi.

⚠ Bu — alohida holat: BrE da IKKITA 'l' va
qo'shimcha 'e' bor.

  AmE: jew-el-ry   (3 bo'g'in)
  BrE: jew-ell-er-y (4 bo'g'in)

⚠ 'a jewel' = qimmatbaho tosh.

⚠ BrE da '-me' qo'shiladi (fransuzcha
yozilish).

⚠⚠ ISTISNO: KOMPYUTER dasturi Britaniyada
ham 'a program' deb yoziladi!

Ya'ni BrE: 'a TV programme' lekin
'a computer program'.

⚠ 164-betda ko'rgan edik: 'flat (tire)' =
'flat tyre, puncture'.

⚠ EHTIYOT: 'tired' (charchagan) va 'to tire'
(charchamoq) ikkala mamlakatda ham 'i'
bilan!

Faqat g'ildirak shinasi BrE da 'tyre'.

⚠⚠ DIQQAT: Britaniyada IKKALA so'z ham bor,
lekin MA'NOSI BOSHQA:
  'a cheque' = BANK CHEKI
  'a check'  = tekshiruv

⚠ 164-betda: AmE 'check (restaurant)' =
BrE 'bill' (hisob).

⚠ 'cheque' — fransuzcha yozilish.

⚠⚠ ENG NOZIK JUFT.

BRITANIYADA ot va fe'l BOSHQACHA yoziladi:
  'practiCe' — OT  ('football practice')
  'practiSe' — FE'L ('to practise')

⚠⚠ PHOTO FILE 14-UNIT VARAG'IDAGI 'ADVICE/ADVISE' BILAN BIR
XIL QOIDA!

⚠ Eslab qolish: alifboda 'C' 'S' dan OLDIN —
otda ham 'C' oldin.

⚠⚠ BU FAQAT IMLO FARQI EMAS — TALAFFUZ ham
boshqa!

  AmE [a-LU-mi-nam]   — 4 bo'g'in
  BrE [al-yu-MIN-i-am] — 5 bo'g'in

⚠ BrE shaklida qo'shimcha 'i' bor.

⚠ Ro'yxatdagi boshqa so'zlar bir xil

exercises.instructionEn: Expressions with prepositions and particles: match the American expression to the British one.
exercises.instructionUz: Predlog va yuklamali iboralar: Amerika iborasini Britaniya iborasi bilan moslang.
exercises.explanationUz:
'EXPRESSIONS WITH PREPOSITIONS AND
PARTICLES' — 7 JUFT.


TO'LIQ RO'YXAT (AmE → BrE):

  different from/than → different from/to
  live on X street    → live in X street
  on a team           → in a team
  on the weekend      → at the weekend
  Monday through Friday → Monday to Friday
  be in the hospital  → be in hospital
  in the future       → in future


⚠ 'A PREPOSITION' va 'A PARTICLE':

     'a preposition' = PREDLOG
        (in, on, at, from, to)
     'a particle' = YUKLAMA
        (up, off, out — frazali
         fe'llardagi qismlar)


⚠⚠ 159-BETDAGI QOIDA TASDIQLANDI:

  159-betda yozgan edik: 'different FROM'
  — Britaniyada 'different than' EMAS.

  ⚠ Bu bet buni tasdiqlaydi:
     AmE: different from/THAN
     BrE: different from/TO

  ⚠ 'different FROM' — IKKALA mamlakatda
  ham to'g'ri, eng xavfsiz variant.


⚠⚠ 'IN HOSPITAL' — MUHIM BRITANCHA QOIDA:

     BrE: 'He is IN HOSPITAL.'
        = U kasalxonada YOTIBDI (bemor).
     BrE: 'He is IN THE HOSPITAL.'
        = U kasalxona BINOSIDA (masalan,
          ishlaydi yoki mehmonga kelgan).

  ⚠ Britaniyada muassasada O'Z VAZIFASI
  bo'yicha bo'lsa ARTIKL TUShADI:

     at school   — o'qiyapti
     at the school — maktab binosida
     in prison   — qamalgan
     in the prison — qamoqxona binosida
     at church   — ibodat qilyapti
     at the church — cherkov binosida

  ⚠ Amerikada esa 'in THE hospital'
  deyiladi.


⚠⚠ HALOL IZOH — 'IN FUTURE':

  Kitob 'in the future → in future' deb
  bergan.

  ⚠ Aslida BRITANIYADA IKKALASI HAM BOR,
  lekin MA'NOSI BOShQA:

     'IN FUTURE' = BUNDAN KEYIN
        'In future, please be on time.'
        = Bundan keyin vaqtida keling.

     'IN THE FUTURE' = KELAJAKDA
        (qachondir)
        'In the future, cars will fly.'
        = Kelajakda mashinalar uchadi.

  ⚠ Ya'ni bu oddiy AmE/BrE farqi emas —
  ikki BOShQA ibora.


⚠ 'AT THE WEEKEND' — BRITANChA:

     BrE: 'What do you do AT the weekend?'
     AmE: 'What do you do ON the weekend?'

  ⚠ Kitob BrE da — mashqlarda 'AT the
  weekend' yozing.


⚠ 'MONDAY TO FRIDAY':

     BrE: 'Monday TO Friday'
     AmE: 'Monday THROUGH Friday'

  ⚠ AmE 'through' aniqroq: juma KIRADI.
  ⚠ BrE 'to' esa biroz noaniq, shuning
  uchun ba'zan 'Monday to Friday
  INCLUSIVE' deyiladi.


⚠ 'IN X STREET' va 'ON X STREET':

     BrE: 'I live IN Oxford Street.'
     AmE: 'I live ON Oxford Street.'

  ⚠ Lekin ikkalasida ham aniq uy raqami
  bilan 'AT':
     'I live AT 12 Oxford Street.'

  ⚠ Photo File 14-unit varag'idagi xat manzili shu qolipda
  edi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a preposition = predlog
  a particle    = yuklama
  an expression = ibora
  a team        = jamoa
  the weekend   = dam olish kunlari
  a hospital    = kasalxona
  the future    = kelajak
  inclusive     = shu jumladan
exercises.bookRef: Coursebook 166-bet, Expressions with prepositions and particles

pairs.whyUz:
⚠⚠ 159-BETDAGI QOIDA TASDIQLANDI.

BrE: 'different from' yoki 'different TO';
AmE: 'different from' yoki 'different THAN'.

⚠ 'different FROM' — IKKALA mamlakatda ham
to'g'ri, eng XAVFSIZ variant.

⚠ Britaniyada 'different than' XATO
hisoblanadi.

BrE: 'I live IN Oxford Street.'
AmE: 'I live ON Oxford Street.'

⚠ LEKIN aniq uy raqami bilan ikkalasida ham
'AT':
  'I live AT 12 Oxford Street.'

⚠ Photo File 14-unit varag'idagi xat manzili shu qolipda edi.

BrE: 'He is IN the football team.'
AmE: 'He is ON the football team.'

⚠ 'a team' — 161-betda ko'rganimizdek,
BrE da ko'plik fe'l olishi mumkin:
'The team ARE playing well.'

⚠ JUDA KO'P ISHLATILADI:

BrE: 'What do you do AT the weekend?'
AmE: 'What do you do ON the weekend?'

⚠ Kitob BrE da — mashqlarda 'AT the weekend'
yozing.

⚠ Vaqt predloglari: 'AT' + aniq nuqta
(at 5 o'clock, at night, at the weekend).

⚠ AmE 'through' ANIQROQ: juma KIRADI.

⚠ BrE 'to' biroz noaniq — shuning uchun
rasmiy matnlarda 'Monday to Friday
INCLUSIVE' deyiladi.

⚠ 'inclusive' = shu jumladan.

⚠⚠ MUHIM BRITANCHA QOIDA: muassasada O'Z
VAZIFASI bo'yicha bo'lsa ARTIKL TUSHADI.

  'in hospital' = bemor sifatida yotibdi
  'in THE hospital' = bino ichida (ishlaydi
     yoki mehmon)

⚠ Shu kabi:
  at school (o'qiyapti) / at the school (bino)
  in prison (qamalgan) / in the prison (bino)

⚠ Amerikada har doim 'in THE hospital'.

⚠⚠ HALOL IZOH: bu ODDIY AmE/BrE FARQI EMAS.

Britaniyada IKKALASI ham bor, lekin MA'NOSI
BOSHQA:

  'IN FUTURE' = BUNDAN KEYIN
     'In future, please be on time.'

  'IN THE FUTURE' = KELAJAKDA (qachondir)
     'In the future, cars will fly.'

⚠ Kitob buni soddalashtirib bergan.
